about.description: CASH issues a fiat-backed stablecoin maintained at parity with its reference currency through reserve backing and redemption mechanisms. It enables fast, low-cost settlement of stablecoin transactions.
about.registryInfo: Bridge Building Inc. - issuer of the CASH stablecoin (USD-backed). Maintained at parity with USD via reserve backing and redemption mechanisms.

fees.revenueNotes: CASH (issued by Bridge Building Inc., a Bridge.xyz subsidiary) is a USD-backed stablecoin maintained 1:1 with USD reserves. Revenue from float income on USD reserves invested in short-duration treasuries and bank deposits (similar to USDC model). Used as the stablecoin rail for Dreamcash equity-perp deployer markets.
